gmdn_terms.name: Vascular catheter introduction set, nonimplantable
gmdn_terms.definition: A collection of nonimplantable, invasive devices intended to provide percutaneous vascular access to enable introduction of a catheter (not included) into the vascular system. It includes a non-steerable introducer sheath with an inner obturator/dilator, and typically an additional access device(s) [e.g., guidewire, introducer needle, syringe, additional dilators] which may include a haemostatic valve to control blood loss, usually to enable arterial access. This is a single-use device.

This is a single-use device.

mri_safety: Labeling does not contain MRI Safety Information
device_description: SENTRANT INTRODUCER SHEATH 16 FR X 28 CM

storage.special_conditions: Store the Sentrant introducer sheath at room temperature in a dark, dry place to avoid extended exposure to light and moisture.
